purpose: Teach: 至急/台帳/雇い/シンクタンク/区民/区内/チームワーク/不明確

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文、本気で、絶対、至急、絶対、確認、絶対、いただきたい、絶対、件がある、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — I need you to review that paper urgently. This is serious.
lines.style: Direct and measured. Steady eye contact. Respects Ren's capability. The tone of someone assigning real responsibility, not testing him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の、本気で、絶対、台帳、絶対、整理、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm organizing the lab records and making progress. Thank you for the guidance.
lines.style: Respectful but not obsequious. Even pace, steady voice. Shows competence and genuine gratitude without performing deference.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究助手の、本気で、絶対、雇い入れ、絶対、教授と、絶対、相談しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Talk to the department head about hiring a research assistant. Don't put this off.
lines.style: Clear instruction. A slight weight on the verb — this is non-negotiable. Not unkind, but firm. Expects compliance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究分野の、本気で、絶対、シンクタンク、絶対、訪問、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm working on visiting research institutes in the field. Thank you for trusting me with this.
lines.style: Quiet acknowledgment. Shows understanding of the task's importance. Measured pace. Genuine, not rushed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 地域の、本気で、絶対、区民、絶対、向けの、絶対、講演、絶対、引き受けろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I'm asking you to take the community lecture at the ward office. This matters.
lines.style: Firm, not harsh. The directness of someone who believes Ren can do it. Slightly slower than usual — letting the weight of the request land.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。区内、本気で、絶対、学校、絶対、訪問、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm visiting schools in the ward and moving forward there too. Thank you for the opportunity.
lines.style: Steady, committed. Shows initiative without overstepping. Quiet pride in the work. Even tempo, genuine voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究室の、本気で、絶対、チームワーク、絶対、大切にしろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Take care of your lab team. They're the real foundation here.
lines.style: Shift to gentler register. More personal. A beat of pause before 'they're' — suggesting this comes from experience. Still authoritative but now mentor-to-student.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の、本気で、絶対、不明確、絶対、な箇所、絶対、教授に、絶対、確認、絶対、いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'll check with you on any parts of the paper that aren't clear to me. Thank you.
lines.style: Final acknowledgment. Slightly softer landing than previous responses. Shows listening — integrating the teamwork advice. Genuine closure.
